raises.name: River
raises.sector: River is building the first chain-abstraction stablecoin system that connects liquidity across ecosystems and channels it into new growth opportunities. Powered by the omni-CDP stablecoin satUSD, River allows users to collateralize assets on one chain and mint on another — natively earning, leveraging, and scaling across networks
